decisions.reason: As a burner component closely tied to the firm's established combustion and radiant-heating knowledge, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and can likely be improved through existing R&D and service feedback.
The electric infrared panel heater builds on the firm's heating know-how, but it is somewhat less distinctive than its core customized system business, so it is likely kept with moderate review risk.

The electric halogen infrared heater is related to the firm's infrared expertise, yet its fit with the firm's energy-efficient, large-space systems positioning is weaker, making it the most at risk though still more likely to be retained for learning.

This industrial electric infrared hall heater is very close to the firm's core application area in large non-residential spaces, so the firm has strong ability to interpret demand and refine the product commercially.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater matches the firm's strategic move toward lower-carbon heating and draws on existing combustion expertise, so despite early-market uncertainty it is likely kept.
